Evidence:
- FI-301 fell from 421.7 to 369.9 m3/h over 12 h (-12.3%). The LO alarm at 385 has been active for 2.4 h.
- PI-301 fell from 14.18 to 12.0 barg, and its LO alarm (12.6) has been active for 1.8 h.
- VI-301A rose from 2.16 to 8.48 mm/s, and its HI alarm (5) has been active for 4.4 h.
- II-301A rose from 181.5 to 202.3 A, and its HI alarm (198) has been active for 1.8 h.
- The change is a steady one-way drift rather than a daily cycle, so it isn't time-of-day or ambient. The open E-302 condenser work order (WO-1201) describes a daily ambient cycle and doesn't explain this. The H-301 burner tune-up closed 5 days ago with no findings.

Recommended action: Plan a changeover to standby P-301B and have P-301A inspected. I've proposed a P1 work order for P-301A, and it needs your approval before it exists. Both pumps are highlighted on the schematic.
